reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that detects mojibake and unsafe text encodings in file writes, shell commands, and selected outputs, then warns, blocks, or routes findings for review; its primary purpose is file and terminal protection against encoding corruption.

summaries.zh: 在文件写入、编辑、Shell 命令及相关输出中检测乱码和不安全编码，并按配置进行警告、拦截或复查。
summaries.en: Detects mojibake and unsafe encodings in file edits, writes, shell commands, and selected outputs, then warns, blocks, or routes findings for review according to configuration.

capabilities: Scans pending file-write, edit, and shell-command payloads before execution
Can deny or allow tool execution based on detected encoding and mojibake patterns
Scans command and read-tool outputs and injects warning notifications
Supports warn, block, and approval-based handling modes
